documents.title: All-new 2017 Hyundai Elantra brings advanced technology and premium convenience to the compact car segment

observations.ALL-NEW POWERTRAINS: SE and Limited: 2.0-liter Nu MPI Atkinson inline-four; 147 hp at 6200 rpm, 132 lb-ft at 4500 rpm, compression 12.5. Six-speed manual is SE-only; six-speed automatic uses a multi-clutch torque converter. Eco 1.4 turbo/7DCT is a separate powertrain.
observations.Improved Proportions table: Sedan dimensions in inches: length 179.9, width 70.9, height 56.5, wheelbase 106.3.
observations.REFINED & RESPONSIVE CHASSIS: Front MacPherson struts; rear coupled torsion beam for these standard powertrains. Do not apply the Sport multilink specification.
observations.OCCUPANT SAFETY: Seven airbags, ESC, vehicle stability management, traction control, ABS and TPMS. Advanced assists are optional equipment, not confirmed on an individual car. The article's expected crash-test rating is not a completed test result.

observations.2018 Hyundai Elantra - Carryover: The 2018 Elantra sedan carries over from the all-new 2017 model. Elantra GT is listed separately as all-new, not a sedan derivative for this verification.
observations.2018 Elantra Summary of Changes: New SEL replaces SE Popular Equipment Package. SEL and Value gain rear disc brakes tied to 16-inch alloys. SEL package includes 205/55 R16 tires. Shale Gray Metallic is replaced with Machine Gray starting May production. No engine or transmission change is listed in this sedan carryover section.

documents.title: Safety Comes First in the Redesigned 2019 Elantra

observations.ENGINE PERFORMANCE: SE, SEL and Limited: Nu 2.0L MPI Atkinson, 147 hp at 6200 rpm. Eco 1.4 turbo and Sport 1.6 turbo are separate variants.
observations.Generation and exterior updates: Sixth generation. Redesigned hood, front fenders, fascia, grille, headlights, trunk and taillights; rear license plate relocated to lower fascia. This is a facelift within the generation, not proof of a new generation.
observations.SAFETY: FCA, lane keep assist and driver attention alert are listed for SEL and above; extra features depend on Limited Ultimate Package. Do not assign all assists to SE or an unidentified trim.
observations.TRIM LEVELS: Six trims: SE, SEL, Value Edition, Limited, Eco and Sport. Sport 1.6 turbo has multilink rear suspension; do not transfer it to 2.0 MPI. Transmission details for 2.0 are additionally bound to the manufacturer TSB 20-AT-007H and same-year EPA configuration.
